title: GET /api/portfolio — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #30 (api-portfolio-get), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: The mark-to-market enrichment logic (fetch current_price per position via the DataProvider, compute unrealized_pnl_pct, sum positions_value, exclude a position whose price fetch failed) is embedded directly in app/api/routers/portfolio.py's get_portfolio handler using the API schema types, rather than as a reusable function in app/portfolio/ built on the existing app.portfolio.models.Position/Equity/Account domain models (which already have the exact shape for this). The still-stubbed GET /api/portfolio/risk endpoint (api-portfolio-risk task) needs position.current_price populated too (per app/portfolio/risk.py's precondition), so as currently structured it will have to duplicate this same fetch-and-degrade-gracefully loop instead of reusing it. Extract into a portfolio-domain function both routes can call.

docs/architecture/Backend.md §2's module layout diagram doesn't list the new app/api/dependencies.py file added by this PR. Not a violation of any documented principle (it fits the existing api/ layer and the get_db dependency-override testing pattern), but the diagram should be updated for accuracy.

get_portfolio's db.query(PositionORM).all() has no explicit order_by, so the order of `positions` in the response isn't deterministic/guaranteed -- it currently relies on incidental SQLite behavior. Low impact for a single-user MVP but worth an explicit stable ordering (e.g. by entry_date or id) for a deterministic API response.
